description.zh: 极连云针对人工智能热潮进行了专门的出口节点清洗与原生 IP 配置，是程序员、设计师和学术科研人员使用海外 AI 工具的高效伙伴。
description.en: JiLian Cloud is a high-performance cross-border proxy provider. Featuring Dedicated Relay / Shadowsocks, Low Latency Gateway, and full support for Netflix, 4K YouTube streaming, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. Starting at ¥18/月.
